name: V64.eligibility-workbook-string-knockout
description: FCA fca-2026-07-25 (S0, dead knock-out gates) — the knock-out-true vector the build checks never had. A workbook-built gate persists its boolean rule value as the TEXT 'true' (spec §2.1 declares that a legal boolean spelling); every schema-typed caller sends a JSON boolean. The strict comparator never matched, so the filed hard-decline (Rule 1.3.C, work above three stories) silently rated Standard on quote AND book paths while the trace asserted 'No rule matched' — and 25/25 build vectors stayed green because none set the flag true. The comparator now bridges the boolean/boolean-literal-string seam exactly like E3 bridged numbers: this vector pins tier=decline for the workbook shape (string RHS, boolean input). The ported money field rides along to prove rating arithmetic is untouched by the verdict.

plan.name: Workbook-string boolean knock-out fires on a typed input

rules.reasoning: Rule 1.3.C: any operations above three stories in height are not eligible.
